title: Oven Steamed Egyptian Penne Rigate Pasta
description: A savory and juicy Egyptian dish featuring penne rigate pasta, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe uses a comal as the cooking vessel and incorporates steam for a unique cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large comal, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the penne rigate pasta, vegetable broth, dried parsley, salt, and black pepper to the comal.
Cover the comal with aluminum foil and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the comal from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
